summary: Reviewed tests/Pagination/GridPaginationTest.php IPP test section (lines 191–402). All Review Dimensions pass.

Correctness: All 9 required IPP scenarios are covered — options sort/dedup/filter, hasIPPOptions default/true, resolveItemsPerPage default chain, settings priority, GET priority, GET persistence, invalid GET ignored, idempotent caching, URL template sentinel concealment, URL page-reset, custom param resolution, and custom-param exclusivity (old 'ipp' ignored when custom param set). 14 test methods in total.
Security: Every $_GET mutation is wrapped in try/finally with unset() — no state leaks between test runs.
Conventions: Section comments, test naming (test_[method]_[scenario]), helper factories, and anonymous-class stub pattern all match the existing GridPaginationTest style.

No blocking issues. One non-blocking note: test_resolveItemsPerPage_isIdempotent is a strict subset of test_resolveItemsPerPage_cacheIgnoresSubsequentDefault — harmless redundancy but recorded for awareness.

Having both is harmless and even desirable for diagnostics, but worth noting in case the test suite is trimmed in future. Non-blocking.

No other observations — test code is well-structured, idiomatic, and covers all 9 required scenarios plus two additional custom-param edge cases. $_GET cleanup via try/finally is correct throughout. Follows established naming and sectioning conventions of GridPaginationTest.
